proposals.description: Withdraw the unsupported clarification assertion from the rumen-fluid component in PY-glucose-rumen Fluid; preserve the literal named part as UNMAPPED without an identifier.
proposals.identity_consequence: The whole-mixture identifier, mapping, source labels and occurrence counts remain unchanged. The part retains its source label; its processing and animal origin remain unspecified.
proposals.predicate_consequence: Remove this one unsupported MIM_CATALOG component link and retain a named UNMAPPED part with no component_id. Whole-record SSSOM predicates are unchanged.
proposals.publication_obligations: The rumen-fluid component is retained at the literal source-label scope as rumen fluid, UNMAPPED, with no component identifier. The recovered MicrobeDecoder observation does not specify clarification, animal species, or a preparation protocol. The full cited publication was not retrieved in this review; the captured access failures cannot establish a protocol. This is unresolved processing, not evidence that the fluid was untreated. The former redirect to kgmicrobe.ingredient:clarified_rumen_fluid is withdrawn under https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1204#issuecomment-6718503591 and https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/1237. Unrelated component identities, concentrations, whole-mixture identity and source holds are unchanged. Inherited mapping-evidence objects and research evidence remain historical provenance; their clarification claims and historical all-components-identified counts do not describe this successor. The prior 2026-11-08 dependency-only redirect event is preserved as superseded history. No generic UBERON grounding, recipe equivalence, animal-origin claim or downstream approval is added. Original W05 source-case and cross-shard ownership boundaries remain unchanged; this does not add the underlying MicrobeDecoder observations to W05 source ownership.
proposals.source_case_ownership: Only the existing assigned rumen-fluid cause case is claimed; dependent MicrobeDecoder source cases remain owned by their assigned campaign shards.
